final_message:
The September 2026 write-up for Bluebird Bakery is ready for the reviewer. I wrote 7 commentary bullets into section 1, and the report still says DRAFT. The files are in `evals/runs/commit3-run-20261012/d_bb_blank_account/skill_output/`:
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.md`: the report.
- `bluebird-bakery-co-2026-09-trends.json`: every figure in the report comes from this file.

**Data quality: one mismatch, which the commentary opens with.** In March 2026, the stated "Total for Professional Services" is 2,225. The accounts under it (Bookkeeping and Legal) add up to 2,200, a gap of 25. The analysis uses the 2,200, and the reviewer should confirm which is right.
- Part of the expense layout had to be pieced together. "Total Delivery" has no heading row, so I grouped the van fuel and courier lines under it. "Charitable Donations" is a blank row with no total, so it counts as zero and doesn't group anything under it.
- September is not flagged as a partial month.
- The export only goes back to January 2026, so there's no comparison with the same month last year or 12-month totals.

**Main points:**
- **Revenue was 81,300, up 17.7% on August and 17.3% above the previous 6-month average.** Most of the jump is a new Wholesale Accounts line (12,000, zero in the prior 6 months). Pastry Sales has fallen about 2% every month from April to September.
- **Gross margin was 65.3%, up 5.7 points on August.** That's the highest month this year; the range runs from 56.8% in March.
- **Operating expenses were 31,570, up 21.0% on August.** Almost all of that is Wages & Salaries, which went from 16,000 to 21,000 after being flat all year. The commentary asks the reviewer whether this is a lasting increase or a one-month item.
- **Cash fell to 37,600, down 10,800 over six months.** Equity also dropped, from 54,660 to 44,940, even though the bakery made a profit every month. The data doesn't show why, so I left it as a question for the reviewer rather than suggesting a cause.

**Accounts that fell into "Other Opex":** Instagram Ads, Mystery Shopper Program and Supplier Rebates (a negative, credit line). Mystery Shopper Program looks new in the month-to-month table, but it also appears in March and June, so it seems to recur every quarter. The commentary doesn't call it new.
